acceptable_answer_points: Identify situational-awareness indicators for repetition and coherence gaps.
Identify tail-focused aggregation, with every displayed claim bound to returned Evidence.
must_not_claim: Do not describe EvidenceSet as human semantic Gold or as automatic hallucination elimination.
Do not add a new Judge, retrieve new neighbors, or alter retrieval scores for the audit.
known_limitations: EvidenceSet is deterministic AUDIT_ONLY and does not automatically delete Claims.
The user-run Gate must observe at least one generated Claim bound to multiple returned Evidence; historical QA success alone does not prove this.
